title: Wait for the dependency notice
when: When a worker's item has an unmet activation, integration or closure gate on another item.
need: Before a new wait on another item, write its dependency edge and require success: integration/fact:merged for merge, closure/fact:deployed:<registered environment> for delivery. Reuse an existing edge only if it records the actual wait. A dependency_cycle refusal names both waits and recovery; resolve ordering with steering before parking. The held item’s own release wait needs no self-edge. The worker checkpoints and parks with the blocker named. When the blocker lands or reaches done, the control plane sends one notice per satisfied gate to the dependent's claim holder, else the project's steering seat, naming the blocker, the gate and any gates still unmet. Coordination-only edges send nothing. Nobody asks steering to relay the wake. Keep your work claim and lane; do not release or end the session; the notice wakes you as holder. A no-holder notice forbids staffing while any activation gate remains unmet.
surface: Dependency-satisfied session message; worker launch dependency-wait teaching
gap: Seen in source and tests only; a live parked worker receiving the notice after a real landing is not yet recorded as evidence.
review: Pending live proof on a parked dependent.
